market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil-driven inflation fears and 4.75%+ yields suppress risk assets. Nasdaq and global equities under pressure. Expect continued bond selloff and EM outflows. Energy outperforms. Crypto choppy at $80K. Key risk: further Iran escalation or surprise Fed hawkishness.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle and structural energy transition support equities over 6-12 months. Apple transition and China policy shift create sector rotation opportunities. Inflation may moderate if Iran de-escalates. Fed likely to pause after current tightening cycle. Valuations will reset but earnings growth (AI, energy, defense) supports recovery.
